title: Sergey Krylov | Product Portfolio
body:
SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER · PRODUCT LEAD · FINTECH · SAAS · MOBILE # Product Can Do It. Hey, I'm Sergey. I've spent 5+ years in product management and over 15 years across digital business and technology. I've worked on everything from consumer fintech and native mobile apps to B2B SaaS and internal product platforms. At Monefit SmartSaver, I led native iOS and Android apps from scratch to launch in 8 months, introduced new investment features and built tools that gave business teams more independence. I also helped turn a founder's idea into a working B2B product. I enjoy getting to the bottom of a problem, making sense of different perspectives and turning that understanding into decisions. I'm equally interested in how the team works together, how people grow and whether we're building something that genuinely makes a difference. Based in Tallinn, Estonia. Open to remote opportunities and relocation. [Email me](mailto:skrylov22@gmail.com) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/s-krylov) · [My CV](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NwEAJ8qCJFFT4MmrZqpQ6yYTH_bhZPYE/view?usp=drive_link) --- ## A few numbers from my latest work ## €365M Platform scale Assets under management at SmartSaver, where I led investment products and digital experiences. ## 50%+ Mobile adoption In \~5 weeks after launch, exceeding our 30% year-end forecast. ## \~30% Passive Income adoption Investors using the automated monthly payout feature I introduced. ## Minutes Campaign publishing Down from 1–3 days, after introducing a self-service banner system. --- ## Selected work Five projects I'm particularly proud of. Different problems, different teams and different kinds of decisions. Some started with unusual customer behavior. Others came from an operational headache, a technical limitation or an idea that hadn't quite become a product yet. Each story covers what I did, why I made certain decisions and what happened afterwards. --- ## A bit about me My path into product management wasn't particularly straightforward. I started in communications and brand strategy, ran my own business, then moved into technology and automation at Swedbank. Eventually, product management brought those experiences together. Customer interviews and UX/design are among my favourite parts of the job. I enjoy asking that extra question that gets past the obvious answer, understanding why people behave the way they do, and working with designers to turn those insights into something useful and intuitive. That background also helps me see a product from different sides. I understand why Marketing and Growth need flexibility, why Legal cares about risk, and what Engineering needs to deliver well. I enjoy bringing those perspectives together, especially when priorities compete. And I care about the team behind the product. How people work together, what motivates them, and whether they have room to grow. I like coaching, sharing context and helping people become more confident in their decisions.

## Let's talk I'm interested in Senior and Lead Product Management opportunities, particularly where I can combine product strategy, customer understanding and hands-on leadership. I enjoy working with people who care about what they build, are willing to question their assumptions and want to keep improving. [Email me](mailto:skrylov22@gmail.com) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/s-krylov) · [My CV](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NwEAJ8qCJFFT4MmrZqpQ6yYTH_bhZPYE/view?usp=drive_link) Selected Work
